Uomo di 52 anni. RX del torace in proiez: 52-year-old man. PA chest X-ray. The collection gives no symptoms or reason for the examination.
Descrivi il reperto, indica dove si trov: Describe the finding, show where it is and conclude.
Opacità omogenea della base destra con m: Homogeneous opacity at the right base with a meniscus-shaped upper margin (concave upwards, higher laterally)
Riquadro dei radiologi del NIH sulla bas: Box drawn by the NIH radiologists on the right base.
Base sinistra e seno costofrenico sinist: Clear left base and left costophrenic angle
Consolidazione del lobo inferiore destro: Right lower lobe consolidation with air bronchogram
Base opaca con menisco e seno obliterato: Opaque base with meniscus and blunted angle = fluid; always check the other side and look for the cause.
Riquadro della lesione disegnato dai rad: Box drawn around the lesion by the NIH radiologists (BBox_List_2017: «Effusion»). No clinical data, histology or follow-up.
Versamento pleurico destro con menisco:: Right pleural effusion with a meniscus: chest ultrasound to quantify it and look for the cause (and to guide thoracentesis if needed)
Il versamento pleurico libero si raccogl: Free pleural fluid collects in the dependent parts: when standing it first blunts the posterior costophrenic angle, seen on the lateral view (about 50-75 ml are enough), then the lateral one on the PA (about 200-300 ml are needed). The typical sign is the meniscus: concave upper margin, higher along the chest wall. A consolidation instead has irregular margins, air bronchogram and does not follow gravity. Ultrasound confirms the fluid, estimates the amount, shows septa and echoes and guides thoracentesis; the cause (heart failure, infection, cancer) is sought clinically and, if needed, by fluid analysis.
Qual è la conclusione e che cosa fai?: What is the conclusion and what do you do?
